canonical_project: TKRZ regional data centers (Emsdetten, Greven, Rheine)
notes: TKRZ states it offers customer server/data hosting in its data centers in Emsdetten, Greven, Rheine and Nordhorn; the first three are in Kreis Steinfurt. City of Emsdetten reported the TKRZ data center opening with 20 new cabinets plus 18 existing cabinets, about 2,000 rack units total.
